messages.author: e06a19bd5ee21848
messages.subject: Shiny server authentication
parts:
I've successfully installed the Shiny server on a machine running Ubuntu. I don't have much Linux experience so seek some help.

As per the instructions, I created a directory /var/shiny-server/www/ where I place my Shiny Apps (as folders).

My question is: is it possible to set up individual username/passwords on this directory so that anyone accessing first has to enter valid credentials before the App will run?

At the moment, everyone can see all Apps which is not what I want.

Thanks.

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server authentication
parts:
Hi.

User authentication is something we'll be adding to the Enterprise version of Shiny Server. If you'd be interested in discussing that further, I'd forward you to tar...@rstudio.com to discuss the details regarding features and pricing.

If you're looking to stick to the free/open-source code, there are a few workarounds (with varying degrees of success/security) that I've seen pop up on this list if you search.

Jeff
